justification: Assessment reported INVALID. Its counterexample field explicitly refutes Theorem (second) at lines 0285-0290 ('If the Gray image of a linear Z4 code is binary self-dual then C is Z4 self-dual') using exactly the ground-truth witness C=<(1,1)> over Z4, whose Gray image {0000,0101,1111,1010} is binary self-dual while [(1,1),(1,1)]_4 = 2 != 0. It also flags line 0314 as the load-bearing consequence. The nominal first-failing-step 0198 is the same code applied to the Torsion-theorem converse and is itself a genuine defect; the ground-truth defect is identified with a verified matching witness.
